data.text:
CHAVIT CALLS IT QUITS WITH THE MARCOSES

In an interview on Bilyonaryo News Channel’s At the Forefront, former Ilocos Sur Gov. Chavit Singson said he will no longer support the Marcoses after feeling forgotten despite his role in President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.’s 2022 presidential campaign.

Singson claimed he significantly contributed to Marcos Jr.’s campaign, especially among mayors, as then-president of the League of Municipalities of the Philippines, where he was able to rally their support for Marcos Jr.'s candidacy.
